digest.component_or_area: plan review caching and prompt infrastructure
propositions: Pass-1 and Pass-2 prompts must share a byte-identical plan-bearing cache prefix to enable provider-side prefix reuse and cross-run cache hits within Anthropic's 5-minute TTL window.
The shared prefix is single-sourced as prompts.shared_plan_prefix(plan) = SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + plan heading + plan text, with no duplicate inline in templates, enforced by code structure.
Pass-1 finder and verifier templates are restructured to begin with {{shared_prefix}} (verifier) or output from _resolve_system (finder) rather than appending {{plan}} at template end.
The per-run finding listing (base_instructions) remains user-turn input under the new architecture; no plan content is moved into user messages.
Pass-1 exhaustiveness directive (enumerate every independent defect in THIS run) is a bullet of SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE, reaching every Pass-1 entry point and the verifier prefix by byte identity.
The Pass-1 warm gate condition is updated to measure the actual cached prefix (shared_plan_prefix) rather than the plan alone, keeping the gate consistent with bytes actually sent.
